description: Compute cost of goods sold from inventory and purchases, plus gross profit and margin from revenue.

faqs.a: COGS = beginning inventory + purchases − ending inventory. It is the direct cost of what you actually sold in the period.
Gross profit = revenue − COGS. Gross margin = gross profit ÷ revenue.
A physical count or a perpetual inventory system. Ending inventory that is too high or low directly distorts COGS and profit.
faqs.q: How do I know ending inventory?

howto: Enter beginning inventory, purchases and ending inventory.
Add total revenue for the period.
Read COGS, gross profit and gross margin.
